limitations: No physical engine, vehicle, GPIO, ADC, RF, EMI/surge, thermal, splash or fit qualification. Native execution has zero CPU/IRQ execution cost;16bit model is timer-width/compare behavior only.

The external FMU supplies manifold thermodynamics/pumping, while local empirical wall film/combustion/free-shaft responses remain uncalibrated. No exhaust thermodynamic plant is added; EMAP125 is an exogenous sensor stimulus.
Manual80kPa fuel-coefficient scaling is a declared fixture calibration, not an implemented separate baro correction curve. No claim of ideal tuning follows from a passed scenario audit.

Combined idle-valve/Alpha-N or enabled cylinder-trim benchmark behavior is not covered by this matrix. Reference independent lambda/trim source and project wideband-ready/freshness/guard policies are explicitly unrepresented.
